info.name: Apache 2.4.49 - Path Traversal and Remote Code Execution
info.description: A path traversal flaw in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 lets attackers map URLs to files outside the document root and, with CGI enabled, execute code.
info.remediation: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server to 2.4.51 or later.
